overview_description.description: Kema is a fintech platform that helps businesses streamline invoicing, automate payment collection, and improve cash flow. It offers tools for managing accounts receivable, tracking payments, and accessing invoice financing. By digitizing financial operations, Kema enables faster transactions, reduces manual work, and supports better financial planning and business growth.

product.name: Payment Links for Every Invoice
product.description: Automatically embeds secure payment links in invoices to facilitate instant payment collection.

product.name: Accounts Receivable (A/R) Automation
product.description: Automates receivables workflows including reminders, reconciliation, and provides real-time tracking via a unified dashboard.

product.name: Invoice Financing
product.description: Provides advance payments on approved invoices, converting receivables into immediate working capital.
